19:
I am the mighty god
in the air and on the earth,
on the broad and billowing sea,
and over all the abyss contains
in its dreadful depths.
I have never known fear.
Whatever I wish, I can do,
even if I wish the impossible;
and in everything possible
I command, remove, appoint, and forbid.
21:
I am more powerful than Love,
and yet Love is my guide.
I belong to the finest lineage
that heaven breeds upon the earth,
the best-known and the greatest.
I am Self-Interest, with whom
few people tend to act well;
to act without me is a great miracle.
Such as I am, I dedicate myself to you
for ever and ever, amen.
23:
In the sweetest thoughts,
lofty, solemn, and discerning,
the sweetest Poetry
sends you her soul, my lady,
wrapped in a thousand sonnets.
If my persistence
does not trouble you, your fortune,
envied by so many others,
will be raised by me
above the circle of the moon.
25:
Giving is called Liberality
when it avoids the extreme
of prodigality,
and its opposite, which reveals
a lukewarm and feeble will.
But to exalt you,
from today I shall be prodigal.
It is a vice, but an honourable vice,
and one belonging to a loving heart,
which shows itself in giving.
